title: Kernel adjunction of the constructed projective-line diagonal datum
statement: Under the positive finite-coefficient, presentation, splitting base-change and finite diagonal hypotheses of [lem-asd-presented-projective-line-trace-adjunction], a supported class gives the explicitly constructed trace-diagonal datum of [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data], and its kernel counit is the counit of an adjunction between compact-support direct image and left tensor by the shifted pulled-back Tate line. This asserts the kernel counit equality, before the comparison with the prescribed ordered inverse-projection counit. The compact-support integrals are [lem-asd-presented-projective-line-kernel-integrals]; the lisse-line and kernel triangle inputs are [lem-asd-finite-etale-tate-local-line] and [lem-sf-diagonal-kernel-integral-triangles].

source.place: Both diagonal triangle calculations and the actual inverse-projection counit.

proof.text: Obtain a supported class whose constructed datum has both compact-support integrals one.

Map the global inverse of N to each stalk. The finite Tate local trivialization gives a lisse rank-one sheaf. Apply the kernel triangle theorem with its shifted pullback comparison, then form the adjunction from the constructed kernel unit and counit and the two triangle equalities.

theorem exists_presentedFiniteP1KernelAdjunction
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (d : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1Splitting A N hA t T hT)
    (hbc : ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t d)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper q]
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine Y) (w : e.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) = q)
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hdiag : finiteP1DiagonalProperty A N hA t d Y hY) :
    ∃ κ : Ext
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.diagonal (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))).obj
        (ordinaryFiniteConstant A (ProjectiveLine Y)))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine
        (pullback (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)) N A hA) 2,
      ∃ adj : rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q ⊣
        CoordinateTrace.pull A q ⋙ (derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj
          ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧),
        adj.counit = SfDiagonalKernel.counit A
          (SfP1Transport.datum A N hA t q e w hY (d Y hY).trace κ)
